skill.name: code-to-music
skill.description: Create instrumental music with code using music21, mido, FluidSynth, and pydub. The skill guides composition, MIDI instrument assignment, MP3 rendering, and audio validation for original music.
skill.summary: Create original instrumental MP3 music from code-driven MIDI compositions.
skill.author: Cam10001110101

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, MIDI terminology, documentation links, and music examples. The real security concern is the setup path: install.sh and SKILL.md instruct installation steps that run apt-get and pip, which modify the local host environment. No prompt injection attempt or data-exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: The installer modifies system packages and the Python environment.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running install.sh, document required privileges, and prefer a virtual environment for Python dependencies.

remediation.issue: The installer uses broad dependency installation commands.
remediation.suggestion: Pin Python dependency versions where practical and document trusted package sources for reproducible installation.

remediation.issue: Temporary MIDI and WAV cleanup removes sidecar files derived from the requested output name.
remediation.suggestion: Write temporary render artifacts into a dedicated temporary directory to avoid overwriting or deleting existing sidecar files.

content.value_statement: Composing instrumental music with code requires MIDI, soundfonts, and rendering steps. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through composition, rendering, and validation.
actual_capabilities: Guides original instrumental composition with music21 patterns and music theory references.
Chooses electronic or traditional MIDI rendering workflows based on the requested style.
Uses General MIDI instrument maps, drum maps, and mido program-change workflows.
Renders MIDI or structured music data to MP3 with FluidSynth and pydub scripts.
Validates audio duration, clipping, silence, loudness, and dynamic range with audio_validate.py.
Provides velocity, mixing, and arrangement guidance for clearer rendered output.
limitations: It creates instrumental music only and does not support vocals or lyrics.
It requires local audio tools, Python packages, and SoundFont files to be installed.
MIDI and SoundFont output will not match professional studio recordings.
It should not be used to replicate protected songs, beats, riffs, or recordings.

use_cases.title: Prototype Original Music Cues
use_cases.description: Create short instrumental themes, loops, and background cues for early creative drafts.

use_cases.title: Render Algorithmic Compositions
use_cases.description: Turn music theory prompts into MIDI-based arrangements and downloadable MP3 files.

use_cases.title: Analyze Rendered Audio Quality
use_cases.description: Check generated files for clipping, silence, duration mismatch, and loudness problems.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for an original short cue.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30 second original instrumental theme as an MP3. Use piano, bass, and light percussion. Keep it bright and simple.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Genre Loop
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with style and arrangement details.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 60 second original deep house loop. Include a syncopated bassline, layered percussion, warm pads, and a clear intro.

prompt_templates.title: Render an Orchestral Cue
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with instruments and musical direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compose a 90 second original orchestral cue in a minor key. Use strings, brass, timpani, and a gradual climax before resolution.

prompt_templates.title: Revise and Validate Output
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced quality-control workflow after rendering audio.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the generated MP3 for clipping, silence, and balance issues. Adjust velocities and arrangement, then render a cleaner version.

output_examples.input: Create a short upbeat electronic intro for a product video.
output_examples.output: A downloadable MP3 with a four-on-floor beat, synth bass, warm pad chords, and a short melodic lead.

output_examples.input: Make a gentle classical-style theme for a calm scene.
output_examples.output: A rendered MP3 using piano, strings, and soft dynamics with a simple intro, development, and ending.

output_examples.input: Check whether my rendered song has clipping or long silence.
output_examples.output: A concise audio quality report with duration, peak level, loudness, silence percentage, and recommended fixes.

best_practices: Give style, duration, mood, and instrument guidance before asking for a render.
Ask for original compositions rather than references to protected songs or recordings.
Validate the MP3 after rendering and revise velocities when instruments are unbalanced.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to copy a known song, beat, riff, melody, or recording.
Do not expect vocals, lyric writing, mastering, or real-time playback.
Do not skip audio validation when the output will be shared or published.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates original instrumental MIDI-based compositions and renders them as MP3 files.

faq.question: Does it support vocals or lyrics?
faq.answer: No. The skill is designed for instrumental music only.

faq.question: Can it copy an existing song?
faq.answer: No. It should be used for original compositions, not protected songs, beats, riffs, or recordings.

faq.question: What tools does it use?
faq.answer: It uses music21, mido, FluidSynth, pydub, FFmpeg, and local SoundFont files.

faq.question: What output format should I expect?
faq.answer: The intended final output is a downloadable MP3 file.

faq.question: Why does setup need extra packages?
faq.answer: Rendering MIDI to audio requires local system audio tools, Python libraries, and SoundFont files.
